title: On, but notifications are not allowed
note: With the switch on and the phone's notification permission not granted, a card with the warning mark says "Notifications are off" and offers "Open Settings" (native; it does nothing on web). The choices below stay editable. When the person comes back from Settings with notifications allowed, the card collapses and "Reminders are on." shows (a phone check). On iOS, the first time, a priming sheet comes before the iOS alert; the web build has no notification permission, so it skips straight to this state. There is one switch for reminders: no separate Pause.
text: Reminders Reminders A nudge in the evening, as often as you choose. Never late at night. Notifications are off Turn them on in Settings to get these reminders. Open Settings How often Weekly A few times a week Every evening Which evenings Sun Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Time Reminder time 8:30 PM Reminders come between 7 AM and 9:30 PM, and stay quiet on a day you have already written. Month and birthday messages A short message on the day a new month begins in each book, and on birthdays. Names in notifications Notifications say "your little one" and show no names on the lock screen.
